payload.plan: AgentPlan(hypothesis='The recent deployment of order-service introduced a regression that increases checkout errors and latency, possibly due to misconfigured database connection pooling or a new dependency causing contention.', steps=[PlanStep(step_id='S1', objective='Collect and analyze recent logs and metrics from order-service and related components (payment, inventory, database).', success_signal='Logs show consistent error patterns and metrics reveal increased latency spikes post-deployment.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S2', objective='Verify the health and configuration of the database connection pool (max connections, timeout).', success_signal='Connection pool metrics are within expected ranges and no connection errors are reported.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S3', objective='Run a canary rollback of the last deployment to a known good version in a staging environment and compare checkout success rate and latency.', success_signal='Staging checkout success rate returns to >99% and p95 latency drops below 800ms.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S4', objective='If rollback restores metrics, perform a controlled rollback in production with monitoring; otherwise, identify the specific code change causing the regression.', success_signal='Production checkout success rate improves to >99% and latency stabilizes.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S5', objective='Implement automated tests for checkout flow and latency thresholds in CI to catch similar regressions before future deployments.', success_signal='CI pipeline now fails on checkout success <99% or p95 latency >800ms.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S6', objective='Verify recovery by running a full end-to-end checkout test against production and confirm metrics meet objectives.', success_signal='End-to-end test shows checkout success >=99% and p95 latency <=800ms, with no active errors.', status='pending')], revision=0, rationale_summary='The incident was triggered after a production change to order-service, and the observed symptoms (checkout errors, reduced success rate, higher latency) align with typical issues from configuration drift or dependency changes. No root cause is confirmed, so we treat the deployment as a likely culprit while remaining open to other possibilities such as external API failures or infrastructure changes.')
